query:
select n.nspname,p.proname,p.oid::regprocedure::text as signature,md5(p.prosrc) as body_md5,p.prosecdef,p.proconfig,
 has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE') as anon_execute,
 has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE') as authenticated_execute,
 has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE') as service_execute
from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
where p.oid in (
 to_regprocedure('private.notification_preferences_settings(public.notification_preferences)'),
 to_regprocedure('private.notification_preferences_write_guard()'),
 to_regprocedure('public.rpc_get_notification_preferences(uuid,text)'),
 to_regprocedure('public.rpc_set_notification_preferences(uuid,text,jsonb,bigint)'),
 to_regprocedure('private.in_quiet_hours(public.notification_preferences)'),
 to_regprocedure('private.emit_event(uuid,text,text,text,uuid,integer,text,text,text,text,jsonb,timestamptz)'),
 to_regprocedure('public.rpc_send_agreement_message(uuid,text)'))
order by n.nspname,p.proname;
